title: VendPoint Minimum Monthly Usage and Shortfall Fee Schedule
content:
Schedule of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program monthly minimum, by machine model.

- **Minimum monthly usage**: net vend value per calendar month, USD, below which the machine shortfall fee applies.
- **Shortfall fee rate**: shortfall fee, percent of the amount by which net vend value falls short of the minimum.
- **Monthly fee cap**: largest shortfall fee for one machine-month (or for a pooled site-month), USD.
- **Site minimum pooling**: whether the minimum may be tested once across all active machines at the ship-to when every one of them allows pooling.
- **Ramp-up months**: full calendar months after the installation month during which the minimum is not tested.
- **Minimum during credit hold**: whether the minimum is still tested in months the machine was locked under a credit hold.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum monthly usage, USD | 400.00 | 750.00 | 1250.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 | 8000.00 |
| Shortfall fee rate | 20% | 20% | 15% | 15% | 12% | 10% |
| Monthly fee cap, USD | 150.00 | 225.00 | 300.00 | 400.00 | 550.00 | 1200.00 |
| Site minimum pooling | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Ramp-up months | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 4 |
| Minimum tested in credit-hold months | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

### Notes to the schedule

1. Pooling is a property of each model: the two locker models do not allow pooling, the coil, carousel and smart crib models do.
2. Ramp-up months are counted as full calendar months after the installation month, so the installation month itself is never one of them.
3. Every model tests the minimum in months the machine was locked under a credit hold.

### Hypothetical figure

On a model with a 15% rate and a 300.00 USD cap, a month whose net vend value falls 1000.00 USD short gives 15% of 1000.00, that is 150.00 USD, below the cap; a month 3000.00 USD short gives 450.00 USD, held at the 300.00 USD cap. The amounts are illustrative only.
